name: Santosh Email
description: Your Gmail, Outlook or any email, poora: read, threads, sort, reply (rich markdown), forward, attachments (incl. Drive files), labels (nested + colours), Gmail drafts, follow-ups, undo send, scheduled and bulk mail. Saved searches, new-mail watcher with rules, snooze (Hoola's own + Gmail's snoozed pile), daily or weekly digest. Gmail settings: vacation auto-reply, signature pushed into Gmail, send-as aliases (send from them too), auto-forward. Asks before sending, deleting or bulk mail
notes: Driven by the email_* tools; this pack holds the delete, bulk-mail, label-delete, Gmail-draft-delete, vacation, signature-push and auto-forward confirm cards. Sending from an alias rides the normal Bhejo draft card; saved searches only list, they change nothing; star colours are impossible through Google's API and are said so plainly
